svg.title: Compare Retained Spread Before Overhead
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-placement-rail-retained-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Spread Before Overhead; subtitle: Illustrative retained dollars per $100 of housing billings.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Independent underwriting examples, not measured market yields or a weighted portfolio forecast. Each bar subtracts only landlord rent and utility pass-throughs. The canonical portfolio retained share remains 45%; these bars are not owner net margins.; caption: A higher apparent spread can disappear through vacancy, slow collection, chargebacks, or an unpriced lease extension.; stages: label: Authorized ALE housing invoice; value: $48 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Illustrative $52 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $48 before overhead. Require a named contracting payer and written coverage dates; an adjuster referral alone does not establish carrier payment liability.; label: Employer purchase-order ACH; value: $45 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Illustrative $55 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $45 before overhead. Match employer purchase-order limits, invoice routing, and ACH settlement terms; fund the gap between landlord due dates and customer receipts.; label: Relocation intermediary invoice; value: $42 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 42.0; detail: Illustrative $58 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $42 before overhead. Identify the intermediary's actual payment obligation and separately expense any platform or placement fee rather than hiding it in rent.; label: Healthcare staffing housing; value: $46 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 46.0; detail: Illustrative $54 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $46 before overhead. Align assignment cancellation terms with landlord exposure and document who pays when a worker changes facilities or leaves early.; label: Direct corporate card booking; value: $44 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 44.0; detail: Illustrative $56 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $44 before overhead. Deduct card-processing costs later as operating expense and preserve signed occupancy records for billing disputes and chargeback responses.

circle.title: label: Authorized ALE housing invoice; value: $48 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 48.0; detail: Illustrative $52 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $48 before overhead. Require a named contracting payer and written coverage dates; an adjuster referral alone does not establish carrier payment liability.

label: Employer purchase-order ACH; value: $45 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 45.0; detail: Illustrative $55 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $45 before overhead. Match employer purchase-order limits, invoice routing, and ACH settlement terms; fund the gap between landlord due dates and customer receipts.

label: Relocation intermediary invoice; value: $42 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 42.0; detail: Illustrative $58 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $42 before overhead. Identify the intermediary's actual payment obligation and separately expense any platform or placement fee rather than hiding it in rent.

label: Healthcare staffing housing; value: $46 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 46.0; detail: Illustrative $54 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $46 before overhead. Align assignment cancellation terms with landlord exposure and document who pays when a worker changes facilities or leaves early.

label: Direct corporate card booking; value: $44 retained per $100 under this illustration; numeric value: 44.0; detail: Illustrative $56 landlord-and-utility cost leaves $44 before overhead. Deduct card-processing costs later as operating expense and preserve signed occupancy records for billing disputes and chargeback responses.

text.title: Assumptions: Independent underwriting examples, not measured market yields or a weighted portfolio forecast. Each bar subtracts only landlord rent and utility pass-throughs. The canonical portfolio retained share remains 45%; these bars are not owner net margins.
